# Contributors

Thank you to everyone who wrote a check. Each rule names its author (a GitHub handle) in its `author`
field; the terminal, the web UI and the MCP server show "by @author" next to contributed rules.
To add yours, see [Contributing a rule](docs/contributing-rules.md). Reports of wrong findings and ideas
for new checks help just as much: `security-warden feedback`.
